records.title: Demand for direct international flights from Tirupati to Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
details:
Shri Meda Raghunadha Reddy: I draw
attention of the Government to the need for commencing direct international
flight services from Tirupati Airport to Dubai and Abu Dhabi, which are major
global aviation hubs providing seamless onward connectivity to Europe and the
United States of America.A substantial number of residents from Annamayya, YSR
Kadapa, Nellore, Ananthapur and Chittoor districts of Andhra Pradeshare
employed in Gulf, Europe and Western countries. Many passengers from this
region travel frequently for employment, higher education, business and family
purposes. Due to the absence of direct international connectivity from
Tirupati, passengers have to travel to Chennai, Bengaluru or Hyderabad to board
international flights. This causes avoidable financial burden, longer transit
time and physical hardship, particularly for senior citizens, women, and
children. Tirupati is one of the most important spiritual destinations in the
country, being the gateway to Tirumala. Direct international flights from
Tirupati would greatly facilitate NRIs residing in Gulf and Western countries
to directly visit Tirumala for Darshan, without multiple domestic transits. Considering
the large expatriate population from the Rayalaseema region, growing
international passenger demand and strategic importance of Dubai and Abu Dhabi
as global transit hubs, there is a strong and compelling case for initiating
direct international flights from Tirupati. I therefore urge the Government for
initiating necessary steps in coordination with airlines and airport authorities,
to operationalize direct international flight services from Tirupati to Dubai
and Abu Dhabi at the earliest, in the interest of passengers and regional
development.
(ENDS)
